**[Cut to modern-day footage of the stadium filled with cheering fans during a Yale Bulldogs game.]**

**Narrator (V.O.):** In 2016, the field was officially named Kelley Field in honor of the Kelley family, longtime supporters of Yale Athletics. The dedication underscores the enduring legacy of this historic venue.

**[Cut to shots of the stadium's surroundings, including the picturesque Yale campus and the city of New Haven.]**

**Narrator (V.O.):** Kelley Field at Yale Bowl is more than just a stadium; it's a testament to the rich history and enduring spirit of college football. Whether you're a Yale Bulldogs fan or a lover of sports history, a visit to this iconic venue is an unforgettable experience.

**[Closing shot: Aerial view of Yale Bowl, with the Yale University campus in the background.]**

**Narrator (V.O.):** This is Kelley Field at Yale Bowl—where tradition meets innovation, and every game is a part of history.

---

**[End of script]**
